Name: Round 1: Welcome Week
Administrators: Each player, roleplaying administration, writes 1 policy that results from your university's contract with AI Corpone. Start it with #universityname. Include a boon (something gained) and a concession (a sacrifice or a cost).
Characters: Each character writes 1 Secret Diary entry starting with #charactername #role #universityname: how are you feeling at the start of this new year with AI, and how are your goals aided or frustrated by the new AI policies?

Name: Round 2: Midterms
Administrators: Each player writes 1 amendment to your policy, based on the problems in the Secret Diaries. Start it with #universityname.
Characters: Each character writes 1 Secret Diary entry: report the extreme results of the policies and amendments, and a big compromise, reluctantly handing something vital over to AI.

Name: Round 3: Finals
Administrators: Each player writes 1 extreme measure, based on the consequences reported so far. Start it with #universityname.
Characters: Each character writes 1 Secret Diary entry: the policies have caused chaos. Now what?

Name: Epilogue: Graduation
Administrators: Each player writes 1 paragraph of a graduation speech about the AI Corpone experiment. Start it with #universityname.
Characters: Each character writes 1 Secret Diary entry: thoughts on the future of their goals, from job hunting to family to research.
